objective: Falsify the GB06-R01, GB06-R02 and GB06-R03 repairs and the integrity, repeatability and scope claims of the Chapter 1 movement, breathing and combat representative slice.
required_inputs: A runnable development build created from the current worktree
The durable evidence file and its producing scripts
assumptions: This review is source-aware and is not a source-blind play-feel evaluation
constraints: Do not use README.md or the implementer's prose report as evidence
Do not treat the partial slice as C1, D3, a full playthrough or playtime evidence
prohibited_changes: Remote push, merge, deployment or publication
expected_outputs: A pass/fail result for an independently rerun npm run test:gate-b
Severity, evidence, reproduction, cause direction and required retest for every finding
acceptance_criteria: The full fixed-step updater chain is exercised with the live RAF stopped

Two fresh contexts produce the same semantic result with no browser errors
tests_required: Reproduce the computed combat-resolver mutation from docs/reviews/gate-b-imp06-slice-rereview.md in a disposable copy
Adversarial source inspection of the engine step, driver and outer runner
known_risks: SwiftShader mobile emulation is not a real-device performance result
Dialogue automation is not a source-blind user-surface play test

rollback_instructions: Remove the engine test step, Gate B driver/runner, package script and evidence entry; restore state to revision 2026-07-31.2.
